title: Add owner requirement to validateApp in libs/shared-contracts
Pass owner (team from package.json) in core-shell, billing and reports
Build all apps locally and verify startup
Open PR, wait for CI, merge, confirm CD deploy

summary: PLAT-103 live. validateApp in libs/shared-contracts now throws when app.owner is missing, empty or whitespace-only. core-shell (platform), billing (payments) and reports (insights) pass owner matching their package.json team. PR #1 in mono merged to main (19474b13); CI and CD succeeded. Assumptions: owner is hardcoded in each app's src because build.js inlines only named imports, so reading package.json at runtime was not practical; the value matches package.json, but nothing enforces that match. Reports was included even though the ticket did not name it, since it also calls validateApp. Only mono was changed; platformkit untouched.
